script_definition: yarn compile:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ts-node -P script/tsconfig.json script/build.ts
yarn compile:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production ts-node -P script/tsconfig.json script/build.ts
rimraf out node_modules app/node_modules coverage && yarn
cross-env NODE_ENV=development TS_NODE_PROJECT=script/tsconfig.json NODE_OPTIONS='--openssl-legacy-provider' parallel-webpack --config app/webpack.development.ts
cross-env NODE_ENV=production TS_NODE_PROJECT=script/tsconfig.json NODE_OPTIONS='--max_old_space_size=4096' parallel-webpack --config app/webpack.production.ts
cross-env NODE_ENV=production TS_NODE_PROJECT=script/tsconfig.json NODE_OPTIONS='--max_old_space_size=4096 --openssl-legacy-provider' parallel-webpack --config app/webpack.production.ts
yarn tslint && yarn eslint-check && yarn eslint
yarn test:unit:cov --runInBand && yarn test:script:cov && yarn test:integration
